name: ManageResources
title: Templates/Platform/Account/ManageResources
summary: The account hierarchy: organizations, groups and workspaces in one `Table` with tree rows (`get-sub-rows`, `v-model:expanded`, a treegrid with the row-focus keyboard map) and row selection. A `PageHeader` with Refresh and Hide details, a toolbar with Create workspace, Create group and the bulk Move, Labels and Delete that act on the selection, and a details panel with Permissions (role bindings of the one selected resource) and Labels tabs. Move picks a new parent in a `Dialog` (never the resource itself or anything inside it); Labels adds and removes labels on every selected resource; Delete counts what is inside in a `ConfirmDialog` and keeps it in Resources pending deletion for 30 days; each ends in a toast, Move and Delete with Undo.

variants.name: Selected
variants.summary: One workspace selected: the bulk actions are enabled, Clear selection shows, and the details panel lists its role bindings and labels.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No resource yet: a flush EmptyState with Create workspace replaces the table; the toolbar stays with the bulk actions disabled.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the table's loading rows under its headers.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The hierarchy did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the table; Retry loads it.
